cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) recorded in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount when the user cancels the withdrawal request

redelegated_amount_before.meaning: HYPE amount held for re-delegation at the start of the redelegateWithdrawnHYPE call, equal to the recorded cancelled withdrawal amount

redelegated_amount_after.meaning: HYPE amount actually carried through the re-delegation process after truncation to 8 decimals

lost_remainder.meaning: HYPE remainder _cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10 lost from the re-delegation process, less than 1e10 wei

assumptions: The re-delegation is performed by an account with MANAGER_ROLE via redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reading _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.
The recorded cancelled withdrawal amount is the HYPE value to be re-delegated through _distributeStake with SpotDeposit.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the lost remainder is stranded in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account; fund-flow location is implementation-dependent, so the conservation relation is expressed at the amount level only.

limitations: Conservation is stated over the re-delegation amount only; the report's accumulating permanent-lock and kHYPE profit-reduction claims are potential and not formalized here.
The remainder bound (less than 1e10 wei) is retained in the lost_remainder symbol meaning rather than as a separate numeric predicate.
